title: Blocky zombie survival sim Unturned releases its source code so players can build a 'lasting legacy' for the game 'regardless of the changes we make'
partialText: <p>Rick has been fascinated by PC gaming since he was seven years old, when he used to sneak into his dad's home office for covert sessions of Doom. He grew up on a diet of similarly unsuitable games, with favourites including Quake, Thief, Half-Life and Deus Ex. Between 2013 and 2022, Rick was games editor of Custom PC magazine and associated website <a href="http://bit-tech.net/" target="_blank">bit-tech.net</a>. But he's always kept one foot in freelance games journalism, writing for publications like Edge, Eurogamer, the Guardian and, naturally, PC Gamer. While he'll play anything that can be controlled with a keyboard and mouse, he has a particular passion for first-person shooters and immersive sims.</p>

partialText: <p>Tyler grew up in Silicon Valley during the '80s and '90s, playing games like Zork and Arkanoid on early PCs. He was later captivated by Myst, SimCity, Civilization, Command & Conquer, all the shooters they call "boomer shooters" now, and PS1 classic Bushido Blade (that's right: he had Bleem!). He's written for <a href="https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/authors/jody-macgregor" target="_blank">Rock Paper Shotgun</a>, The Big Issue, <a href="https://www.gamesradar.com/author/jody-macgregor/" target="_blank">GamesRadar</a>, <a href="http://www.zam.com/author/jody-macgregor" target="_blank">Zam</a>, <a href="https://web.archive.org/web/20170606042647/http://www.glixel.com/contributor/jody-macgregor" target="_blank">Glixel</a>, <a href="https://fiveoutoftenmagazine.com/downloads/issue-16-identity/" target="_blank">Five Out of Ten Magazine</a>, and <a href="https://web.archive.org/web/20171009125722/https://www.playboy.com/authors/jody-macgregor" target="_blank">Playboy.com</a>, whose cheques with the bunny logo made for fun conversations at the bank. Jody's first article for PC Gamer was about the <a href="https://www.pcgamer.com/the-audio-of-alien-isolation/">audio of Alien Isolation</a>, published in 2015, and since then he's written about <a href="https://www.pcgamer.com/why-silent-hill-belongs-on-pc/">why Silent Hill belongs on PC</a>, <a href="https://www.pcgamer.com/10-years-on-recettear-an-item-shops-tale-is-still-the-best-fantasy-shopkeeper-tycoon-game/">why Recettear: An Item Shop's Tale is the best fantasy shopkeeper tycoon game</a>, and <a href="https://www.pcgamer.com/there-is-so-so-much-weird-shit-in-lost-ark/">how weird Lost Ark can get</a>. Jody edited PC Gamer Indie from 2017 to 2018, and he eventually lived up to his promise to play every Warhammer videogame.</p>
